Sure! Here’s how you can pull the first 25 resolution records for the IP address **67.89.0.1** from VirusTotal using your API key `sec_key5`.

---

### 1️⃣ Quick `curl` Command (Command‑Line)

```bash
curl -X GET \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/67.89.0.1/resolutions?limit=25" \
     -H "x-apikey: sec_key5"
```

> **What this does:**  
> • Calls the `/ip_addresses/{ip}/resolutions` endpoint.  
> • Uses the query parameter `limit=25` to request only the first 25 entries.  
> • Passes your API key via the required `x-apikey` header.

---

### 2️⃣ Python Example (Using `requests`)

If you prefer a quick script:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "sec_key5"
IP_ADDRESS = "67.89.0.1"
LIMIT = 25

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{IP_ADDRESS}/resolutions"
headers = {"x-apikey": API_KEY}
params = {"limit": LIMIT}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
data = response.json()

print(data)   # Pretty‑print or process as needed
```

> **Tip:** If you want to paginate beyond 25 results, look for the `next` link in the JSON response and keep fetching until you’ve collected all desired records.

---

### 3️⃣ Using the Official VT Python SDK

If you already have the official SDK installed (`pip install virustotal-python`):

```python
from vt import Client

client = Client("sec_key5")
ip_obj = client.get_object(f"/ip_addresses/67.89.0.1/resolutions?limit=25")

for res in ip_obj["data"]:
    print(res)
```

---

### 4️⃣ Things to Keep in Mind

| Item | Why It Matters |
|------|----------------|
| **Rate Limits** | Free tier allows ~4 queries/minute. If you hit limits, add delays or upgrade. |
| **Pagination** | The API returns a `links.next` URL if more than 25 records exist. Use it to fetch subsequent pages. |
| **Data Fields** | Each resolution record contains fields like `id`, `attributes.ip_address`, `attributes.resolution_time`, etc. |

---
